name: JM CLOUD CONTACT SERVER
identity: General Estate cloud/server body. No single device, app or route owns the server boundary.
new_in_v0_3: admin audit events in the same signed chain
v0.2 persisted-member credential compatibility with upgrade-on-rotation
authority: Admin may queue only commands explicitly advertised by the active target member capability set. Revoked members cannot authenticate. Members may emit events/signals only when capability-authorized.

security.member: unique per-space credential; keyed hash persisted instead of raw credential
security.journal: SHA-256 chained events + HMAC server signatures
security.production: refuses wildcard origins and short secrets

routes.POST /v3/spaces: create generic contact space and members

claim_boundary: Deployment-ready and locally proved does not mean publicly deployed. Server-side proof does not impersonate device/app/game/site consequence. NO DING, NO CLAIM remains route-specific.

firstPublicDing.route: HTTPS -> SPACE -> MEMBER EVENT -> COMMAND -> ACK -> RESULT -> CLOSE -> SIGNED RECEIPT
firstPublicDing.claimBoundary: Proves public hosted server/browser contact; does not prove a separate physical/app endpoint consequence.
